integrity: The infinite-time theorem follows from the written exact-ratio proof; numerical reproduction supports one special example and is not an independent proof or external validation.
limitations: Deterministic two-population weak competition only (bf>ce), with a viable resident, strictly positive density-independent periodic pulses, and exact critical invasion equality; general interactions and random pulse times are outside scope. A related 2005 paper was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Phase-resolved critical extinction under staggered ecological pulses
